articles.summary: “We are a small team moving fast, and contracts do not wait for us to catch up. We could review, or we could draft, or we could file, but doing all of it well through four different tools was where things fell through the cracks. With Lexi, a contract moves through one flow, and I approve the work instead of assembling it.” Aman Mishra, Co-Founder and CEO, Unsiloed AI
articles.title: Turning Silos Into a Single Flow: How Unsiloed AI Runs Every Contract End to End With Lexi
